newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes stronger vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes stronger vs dollar.

text.p: Rising call rates helped the Bangladesh taka finish stronger at 43.2900/2940 to the dollar for a second straight session of interbank market on Sunday, dealers said. The previous close was 43.2920/2950.

There were very few deals in foreign currency as the banks put overwhelming attention to trade in local unit amid a liquidity crunch caused by Thursday's auction of central bank bills worth over two billion taka. The taka opened in wide range at 43.2700/2900 per dollar but deals centred at around 43.2920.
The call money was traded at 9 to 11 percent against Saturday's 9-10 percent. Friday is the weekend in Bangladesh.
